cues.en: Hello, everyone. My name is Alex. And in this screencast, I'm going to help you get up and running with I three. First off, what is I three? I three is a window manager for Linux.
cues.zh: 大家好，我叫Alex。在这期 screencast 中，我将帮助大家快速上手 i3。首先，i3 是什么？i3 是 Linux 的窗口管理器。

cues.en: What is a window manager, you might be asking? Well, a window manager is software that controls the placement
cues.zh: 你可能会问，什么是窗口管理器？窗口管理器是一种控制窗口位置

cues.en: and appearance of windows.
cues.zh: 和外观的软件。

cues.en: Every system has a window manager, but what makes I three particularly interesting
cues.zh: 每个系统都有窗口管理器，但 i3 特别有意思的地方在于

cues.en: is that it is specifically a tiling window manager.
cues.zh: 它专门是一种平铺式窗口管理器。

cues.en: Rather than trying to explain what that means, I'll show you. If I open a window, for example, the terminal window, you can see that it automatically
cues.zh: 与其解释这是什么意思，不如直接演示给你看。比如我打开一个窗口——终端窗口，你可以看到它会自动

cues.en: fills all of the available screen space. So there's absolutely no wasted screen space. It's all working space.
cues.zh: 填满所有可用的屏幕空间。所以完全没有浪费屏幕空间，全都是工作区。

cues.en: When I open a second window, the screen space is split evenly among the two windows. I can then switch between window one
cues.zh: 当我打开第二个窗口时，屏幕空间被两个窗口均分。然后我可以在窗口一

cues.en: and window two. When I open a third window, window three, the screen space is split evenly again.
cues.zh: 和窗口二之间切换。当我打开第三个窗口——窗口三时，屏幕空间再次被均分。

cues.en: At this point, I'm kind of running out of horizontal screen space so I can start to insert windows vertically. For example, I can insert window four down here.
cues.zh: 此时，横向屏幕空间快用完了，所以我可以开始垂直插入窗口。比如，我可以在这里往下插入窗口四。

cues.en: At this point, it should be fairly obvious why it's referred to as a tiling window managers.
cues.zh: 这时应该很明显为什么它被称为平铺式窗口管理器了。

cues.en: The windows are effectively tiled in such a way that no window covers another.
cues.zh: 窗口实际上是平铺排列的，没有任何窗口覆盖另一个窗口。

cues.en: Even though I three is predominantly
cues.zh: 尽管 i3 主要

cues.en: a tiling window manager,
cues.zh: 是平铺式窗口管理器，

cues.en: it's also possible to stack windows like this and then flick between the various windows stacked at the top. You can also then go back into the floating mode.
cues.zh: 也可以像这样堆叠窗口，然后在顶部堆叠的各个窗口之间切换。之后你还可以回到浮动模式。

cues.en: You can even tab windows like this. It's all tab like in a browser and then go back to the floating window mode.
cues.zh: 你甚至可以像这样把窗口标签化。就像浏览器里全是标签页一样，然后再切回浮动窗口模式。

cues.en: Also, as you can probably appreciate,
cues.zh: 另外，你可能也深有体会，

cues.en: some windows would look a bit ridiculous if you maximize them. For example, dialogues.
cues.zh: 有些窗口如果最大化，看起来会有点滑稽。比如对话框。

cues.en: Look at this password dialogue. Imagine if it was maximized, it would look quite disproportionate.
cues.zh: 看看这个密码对话框。想象一下它被最大化，比例会非常失调。

cues.en: It's for that reason that I three also supports floating windows,
cues.zh: 正因如此，i3 也支持浮动窗口，

cues.en: which is something most of you are familiar with from your experience with other operating systems because most operating systems have a floating window manager. Throughout this clip, I used a whole bunch of keyboard shortcuts
cues.zh: 这一点你们大多数人从其他操作系统的使用经验中都很熟悉，因为大多数操作系统都有浮动窗口管理器。在这段视频里，我用了一堆键盘快捷键

cues.en: and didn't really tell you which keyboard shortcuts I'm using. That's because this isn't the tutorial part of the video. That was just a quick demonstration to explain what I three is so that those of you who are interested in it can continue watching.
cues.zh: 但没怎么告诉你我用的是哪些快捷键。因为这不是视频的教程部分。那只是个快速演示，解释 i3 是什么，好让感兴趣的人能继续看下去。

cues.en: In the next clip, I'll take a clean installation of Ubuntu and show you how to install I three on Ubuntu,
cues.zh: 下一段视频里，我会拿一个全新安装的 Ubuntu，演示如何在 Ubuntu 上安装 i3，

cues.en: but bear in mind you can install I three on virtually any Linux distribution.
cues.zh: 但请记住，你几乎可以在任何 Linux 发行版上安装 i3。

cues.en: Once I three is installed,
cues.zh: i3 装好之后，

cues.en: I'm going to show you specifically which keyboard shortcuts to use to do some of the things that I've showed you in this clip. Okay, everyone. I'm currently on a clean installation of Ubuntu.
cues.zh: 我会具体演示该用哪些键盘快捷键来完成我在这段视频里展示的一些操作。好了各位。我目前在一个全新安装的 Ubuntu 上。

cues.en: I'm going to log in to the desktop and then install I three, which I can do by firstly opening the terminal. I'm writing in sudo apt get install
cues.zh: 我要登录桌面，然后安装 i3，首先打开终端就能装。我输入 sudo apt get install

cues.en: I three. I'll be prompted to enter my password and to confirm.
cues.zh: i3。系统会提示我输入密码并确认。

cues.en: I'll enter my password and press y for yes.
cues.zh: 我会输入密码，然后按 y 确认。

cues.en: And just like that, three will begin installing.
cues.zh: 就这样，i3 就会开始安装。

cues.en: Once the installation has complete, you can log out
cues.zh: 安装完成后，你可以注销

cues.en: and then from this menu here,
cues.zh: 然后在这个菜单里，

cues.en: you can choose I three to be your desktop environment.
cues.zh: 你可以选择 i3 作为桌面环境。

cues.en: When you log in again, you'll be prompted to configure I three for the first time.
cues.zh: 再次登录时，系统会提示你首次配置 i3。

cues.en: Firstly, you'll have to tell I three whether or not you want it to generate a configuration file. I recommend that you press enter for yes.
cues.zh: 首先，你需要告诉 i3 是否要生成配置文件。我建议按回车选择“是”。

cues.en: Secondly, it will ask you to choose your mod key. Now the mod key can either be the Windows key or the Alt key and it contributes to the keyboard shortcuts that you'll use when you use I three. I recommend you choose the Windows key, but if you want to choose the Alt key, just use your arrow keys to navigate up and down and then hit enter.
cues.zh: 其次，它会让你选择 Mod 键。Mod 键可以是 Windows 键或 Alt 键，它会影响你使用 i3 时的键盘快捷键。我建议选 Windows 键；但如果你想选 Alt 键，就用方向键上下选择，然后按回车。

cues.en: And just like that, you're in the I three desktop.
cues.zh: 就这样，你就进入 i3 桌面了。

cues.en: Before I jump in and show you guys the basic commands, I wanna help put some of your minds at ease.
cues.zh: 在我开始展示基本命令之前，我想先让大家放心一些。

cues.en: Looking at I three now, it looks pretty regressive and frankly pretty ugly,
cues.zh: 现在看 i3，它看起来挺简陋，坦白说还挺丑，

cues.en: but don't fret. Out of the box, yes, I three does not look very good. However, it's incredibly customizable.
cues.zh: 但别担心。默认状态下，i3 确实不太好看。不过，它的可定制性极强。

cues.en: In this video, we're going to look past the aesthetics and focus on the functionality.
cues.zh: 这期视频里，我们会跳过外观，专注于功能。

cues.en: In a subsequent video, call it part two if you like, I'll show you how to configure your system and how to theme your system to look a bit more like the one you saw at the start of this video. With that out of the way, the first thing I'm going to show you how to do is open the terminal. Now because opening the terminal is something you do so commonly in Linux, there's a built in keyboard shortcut for it, namely mod and enter.
cues.zh: 在后续视频中——你可以叫它第二部分——我会展示如何配置系统，以及如何给系统设置主题，让它看起来更像这期视频开头你看到的那个。说完了这些，我首先要教你的是如何打开终端。因为在 Linux 中打开终端非常常用，所以有一个内置快捷键，也就是 Mod + Enter。

cues.en: Now when I refer to mod, I'm either referring to the Windows key or the alt key depending on which key you chose when you configured I three when you first loaded it. To close the window, press mod, shift, and q, q for quit.
cues.zh: 这里提到mod时，指的是Windows键或alt键，取决于你初次加载i3配置时选择的哪个键。要关闭窗口，按mod、shift和q，q代表退出。

cues.en: To open an application aside from the terminal, firstly, press mod and d. This will open up an application called d menu. It's this black bar at the top of a little search input in the top left hand corner. In that input, you can search for the program you want to load, for example, Firefox,
cues.zh: 要打开终端以外的应用，首先按mod和d。这会打开一个叫d menu的应用。它就是屏幕顶部那条黑色栏，左上角有个小搜索框。在那个输入框里，你可以搜索想要加载的程序，比如Firefox，

cues.en: hit enter,
cues.zh: 按回车，

cues.en: and the application will load. To close that window, you press the same key binding as you did for the terminal, namely mod shift and q. Remember, it's q for quit. There are a lot of key bindings in I three to be honest, and it can be a bit daunting thinking about how you can possibly remember them all. Well, most of them are pretty intuitive, especially when you think about the letters in terms of their actions, for example, thinking of q as quit. Next, I'll show you how to tile windows.
cues.zh: 应用就会加载。要关闭那个窗口，按和终端一样的快捷键，也就是mod、shift和q。记住，q代表退出。说实话，i3里有很多快捷键，想到要全部记住可能有点吓人。不过大多数都挺直观的，尤其是当你把字母和它们的动作联系起来想，比如把q想成退出。接下来，我演示如何平铺窗口。

cues.en: So first of all, let's open a terminal application by pressing mod and enter.
cues.zh: 首先，按mod和回车打开一个终端应用。

cues.en: Say I want to create a second terminal and I want to tile it to the right hand side, I simply press mod and enter again to open a second terminal. I three will automatically tile the windows and it will continue to do this infinitely,
cues.zh: 假设我想再开一个终端，并把它平铺到右侧，我只需再按一次mod和回车打开第二个终端。i3会自动平铺窗口，并且会一直这样无限继续，

cues.en: at which point it starts to look a bit ridiculous. So I'll close most of the terminals
cues.zh: 到那时看起来就有点荒唐了。所以我会关掉大部分终端

cues.en: and now that I'm almost out of horizontal screen space, I'm I'm going to insert a window vertically.
cues.zh: 现在水平屏幕空间快用完了，我要垂直插入一个窗口。

cues.en: To do that, I'm firstly going to press mod plus v. This tells I three that the next window that you open should be inserted vertically.
cues.zh: 为此，我首先要按下 mod 加 v。这告诉 i3，你打开的下一个窗口应该垂直插入。

cues.en: First for now, when I press mod and enter to open the terminal, it's inserted vertically.
cues.zh: 现在，当我按下 mod 加 enter 打开终端时，它是垂直插入的。

cues.en: Right now, the window in the bottom right has focus.
cues.zh: 目前，右下角的窗口处于聚焦状态。

cues.en: I know this one because the cursor is flashing and two because the border is blue which indicates that that window has focus.
cues.zh: 我知道这一点，一是因为光标在闪烁，二是因为边框是蓝色的，这表明该窗口拥有焦点。

cues.en: But say I want to move to another terminal,
cues.zh: 但假设我想切换到另一个终端，

cues.en: well, what I could do is I could take my hand and use my mouse and whichever window the cursor is under will gain focus. So for example, I can give focus to this window and start typing.
cues.zh: 嗯，我可以通过把手移向鼠标来操作，光标在哪个窗口下面，哪个窗口就会获得焦点。比如，我可以让这个窗口获得焦点并开始打字。

cues.en: However, it's a bit of a pain to have to keep reaching for the mouse. I'd much rather stay on my keyboard and that's entirely possible in I three. If you want to move between windows using the keyboard,
cues.zh: 不过，总是去够鼠标有点麻烦。我更愿意留在键盘上，而在 i3 中这完全是可以实现的。如果你想用键盘在窗口之间切换，

cues.en: firstly, and hold the mod key and then press the arrow key in the direction that you want to go. So for example, I want to give focus to the window above the currently focused window, so I'll press and hold the mod key and press the up arrow key. To move to the left, I'll press the left arrow key. To move to the left again, I'll press the left arrow key again all while holding the mod key. It's all pretty intuitive.
cues.zh: 首先，按住 mod 键，然后按你想去的方向的箭头键。例如，我想把焦点切到当前聚焦窗口上方的窗口，所以我按住 mod 键并按向上箭头键。要向左移动，我按左箭头键。再次向左移动，我再按一次左箭头键，全程都要按住 mod 键。这一切都非常直观。

cues.en: The only thing I'll mention at this point that might be a little bit advanced for some of you is that you could optionally use the j k l or semicolon keys instead of the arrow keys. Do me a favor and look at your keyboard.
cues.zh: 我在这里要提到的唯一一点对你们某些人来说可能有点高级的内容是，你也可以选择使用 j、k、l 或分号键来代替箭头键。帮个忙，看一眼你的键盘。

cues.en: The j, k, l, and semicolon keys are in a very central position on your keyboard, which means that they're very quick to access. In fact, they're on the home row, and in general, seem to think that the home row is the most convenient place for keys to be. If you've ever used a BIM editor before, these key bindings will seem really familiar to you. If they seem a bit too esoteric and like they're not really worth using, then don't worry about it. Just stick to the arrow keys. From this point on, I'm only going to mention the arrow keys, but understand that whenever I mentioned the arrow keys, you could optionally use the j k l or semicolon keys. At the start of this video, I showed you that you could put the windows in a sort of stacking mode or a tab mode. I'm going to show you that again, but this time with commentary about which key bindings I'm using.
cues.zh: 键盘上的 J、K、L 和分号键都位于非常居中的位置，因此按起来非常方便快捷。事实上，它们就在主键区（Home Row）上。一般来说，大家似乎都认为主键区是放置按键最方便的位置。如果你以前用过 BIM 编辑器，这些按键绑定应该会让你感到非常熟悉。如果你觉得它们有点太小众，似乎不太值得使用，也不用担心，直接使用方向键就好。从现在开始，我只会提到方向键，但你要知道，每当我提到方向键时，你也可以选择使用 J、K、L 或分号键。在视频开头，我向你展示过如何将窗口设置为堆叠模式或标签页模式。现在我会再演示一次，不过这次会同时说明我使用了哪些快捷键。

cues.en: To make this simple, I'm just gonna close the two rightmost windows.
cues.zh: 为了简单起见，我只关掉最右边的两个窗口。

cues.en: Now to put these windows in a stacking mode, I press and hold the mod key and s, s for stacking, and then to flick between the tabs at the top there, I press and hold the mod key and use the up and down arrow keys.
cues.zh: 现在要将这些窗口切换到堆叠模式，我按住 mod 键不放并按下 s，s 代表 stacking（堆叠），然后要在顶部标签页之间快速切换，我按住 mod 键不放并使用上下箭头键。

cues.en: If I want to put the windows back into the,
cues.zh: 如果我想把窗口放回那个，

cues.en: tiling mode, I can press and hold the mod and e key and that will take it back to the tiling mode. To go into the tab mode, I press mod and w and then flake between the tabs using the arrow keys while holding the mod key. So that's mod and right to move right, mod and left to move left. And then if I wanna go back into the tiling mode, I'll press mod and e. Me personally, I only ever really use the tiling mode, but your work may differ so it's worth mentioning nonetheless.
cues.zh:
平铺模式，我可以按住 mod 键和 e 键，这会把它切回平铺模式。
@@
要进入标签页模式，我按 mod 键和 w 键，然后在按住 mod 键的同时，用方向键在标签页之间切换。
@@
所以按 mod 加右箭头向右移动，mod 加左箭头向左移动。
@@
然后如果我想回到平铺模式，我会按 mod 键和 e 键。
@@
就我个人而言，我实际上只用平铺模式，但你的工作流程可能会有所不同，所以还是值得提一下的。

cues.en: Something else you may find yourself wanting to do is resize windows to make one window larger than another. Say for example, I want to make this window on the left here wider.
cues.zh: 你可能还想做的一件事是调整窗口大小，让一个窗口比另一个更大。比如，我想让左边这个窗口更宽一些。

cues.en: Well, to do that, I must first enter resize mode which I can do by pressing and holding mod and then pressing r.
cues.zh: 好，要做到这一点，我必须先进入调整大小模式，方法是按住 mod 键不放，然后按 r 键。

cues.en: And as you can see in the bottom left, we have a red box with the text resize in it which indicates that we're in resize mode. Here, I'll press escape to exit resize mode. That red box disappears and watch carefully as I press mod and r again to enter resize mode. When you're in resize mode, you can simply press the right arrow key to make the window bigger and the left arrow key to make the window smaller.
cues.zh: 正如你在左下角看到的，我们有一个带文字“resize”的红框，这表示我们处于调整大小模式。这里，我按 escape 键退出调整大小模式。那个红框消失了，仔细看，当我再次按下 mod 和 r 键进入调整大小模式时。当你处于调整大小模式时，你只需按右方向键就能让窗口变大，按左方向键就能让窗口变小。

cues.en: What I really mean to say is you should press the right arrow key to make it wider and the left to make it narrower because you can also make the windows taller or shorter if you have vertical windows.
cues.zh: 我真正想说的是，你应该按右方向键让它变宽，按左方向键让它变窄，因为如果你使用的是垂直窗口，你还可以让窗口变得更高或更矮。

cues.en: Now it might seem like because we're pressing the right arrow key that it's making the window bigger in that direction,
cues.zh: 现在看起来，因为我们按的是右方向键，它就在那个方向上把窗口变大了，

cues.en: but really it's a predefined key. If I go to the right hand side window,
cues.zh: 但实际上这是一个预定义的按键。如果我走到右边的窗口，

cues.zh: 进入调整大小模式，然后按右方向键，它会向左侧方向变大。所以别被这个搞糊涂了。你可能感兴趣的另一件事是如何移动窗口。比如，我右边这里有 terminal

cues.en: two on the right hand side here and terminal

Well, to do that, I press and hold mod shift and then press the arrow key in the direction that I want the window to go. I So want this window to go to the right hand side, so I press the right arrow key. And lo and behold, terminals one is on the right. cues.zh: 左边这里有 terminal one。假设我想把 terminal one 移到右边。好，要做到这一点，我按住 mod shift 键不放，然后按我想让窗口移动方向的方向键。我想要这个窗口去到右侧，所以我按右方向键。你看，terminal one 已经在右边了。如果我想把它移回来，我按住 mod shift 键不放，然后按左方向键。

It's really pretty intuitive.
cues.zh: 如果我再引入第三个窗口，也就是终端三，这一点就会明显得多。假设我想把它放到右侧，因为它显然会按一、二、三的顺序排列，我只需按 mod shift 加右箭头键。为了完整起见，我还要展示一下，如果你有一个垂直窗口——按 mod 加 v，再按 mod 加回车就能创建——你可以按住 mod shift 再按上箭头键把它移到上方，按 mod shift 加下箭头键把它移回来。这真的非常直观。

cues.en: Let's close all these windows by pressing mod shift and q. The next feature I want to show you is workspaces.
cues.zh: 我们按 mod shift 加 q 关闭所有这些窗口。接下来我想展示的功能是工作区。

cues.en: And whilst virtually every operating system now has workspaces,
cues.zh: 虽然现在几乎所有操作系统都有工作区，

cues.en: I think they are especially powerful in I three for reasons that I'll explain in just a little bit. First though, I want to show you the basic idea.
cues.zh: 但我认为它们在 i3 中尤其强大，原因我稍后会解释。不过首先，我想给你展示基本概念。

cues.en: So workspaces simply are an easy way to group a set of windows. Say for example, you have a couple of terminals open and you might be writing some commands in this terminal while running a script in the other for example.
cues.zh: 工作区就是一种对一组窗口进行分组的简便方法。比如，你打开了几个终端，可能在这个终端里写一些命令，同时在另一个终端里运行脚本。

cues.en: And then you think, oh, I want to check the documentation. You open up Firefox by pressing modern d and then entering Firefox
cues.zh: 然后你想，哦，我想查一下文档。你按 mod 加 d 打开 Firefox，然后输入 Firefox

cues.en: and you've kind of ran out of space. The window is just too narrow to read most websites. So at this point, you're looking for a sort of maximize button and you're like, I wanna make this window full screen. There is no maximize button in I three. What you really want to do is put the browser on its own workspace.
cues.zh: 然后你发现空间不够了。窗口太窄，大多数网站都读不了。这时你会找类似最大化按钮的东西，想让这个窗口全屏。i3 里没有最大化按钮。你真正该做的是把浏览器放到它自己的工作区。

cues.en: To do that, give the window focus
cues.zh: 为此，先让窗口获得焦点

cues.en: and then press and hold modern shift and then press at the number of the workspace that you want to move the active window to. For example, I'll move this window to workspace number two. Watch in the bottom left. The number one indicates that I'm currently on workspace one. But as I press mod shift and two, it creates a second workspace.
cues.zh: 然后按住 mod 加 shift 键，再按你想把当前窗口移动到的工作区编号。例如，我要把这个窗口移到 2 号工作区。看左下角。数字 1 表示我现在在 1 号工作区。但当我按 mod + shift + 2 时，它创建了第二个工作区。

cues.en: Firefox has moved there. It's no longer on workspace number one. And then to go to that workspace, I just press mod and two and that takes me to workspace number two.
cues.zh: Firefox 已经移到那里了。它不在 1 号工作区了。然后要切换到那个工作区，我只需按 mod + 2，这就会把我带到 2 号工作区。

cues.en: Say I want to move it back again, I make sure that Firefox is focused and then I press mod shift and one to move it back to the first workspace.
cues.zh: 假设我想把它移回来，我确保 Firefox 处于焦点状态，然后按 mod + shift + 1 把它移回第一个工作区。

cues.en: The workspace is empty now. If I move to workspace number one, you can see the two is removed from the bar because it no longer exists.
cues.zh: 这个工作区现在空了。如果我切换到 1 号工作区，你可以看到栏上的 2 消失了，因为它已经不存在了。

cues.en: You know, one thing I struggled with when I first started using I three was adapting to this mental model. It's quite radically different than anything I've used before and it does kinda go against the grain of what you've probably used in your experience with computers. So it does take a little bit of time to get used to, but once you do it, it's tremendously powerful
cues.zh: 你知道，我刚开始使用 i3 时遇到的一大难点就是适应这种心智模型。它和以往用过的任何东西都有很大不同，确实有点违背你以往使用电脑的直觉。所以确实需要花点时间去习惯，但一旦习惯了，它就会变得极其强大

cues.en: and I'll show you why on my other computer.
cues.zh: 我会在另一台电脑上向你展示原因。

cues.en: So here we are back on my personal computer.
cues.zh: 好，我们回到了我的个人电脑上。

cues.en: The key bindings are going to be exactly the same, but what I really want to do is take this opportunity to demonstrate how powerful the workspaces in I three can be. I'm using my system because I've obviously configured it in a way that facilitates my workflow.
cues.zh: 按键绑定完全一样，但我真正想做的是借此机会演示 i3 的工作区有多强大。我用自己的系统是因为我显然已经对它进行了配置，以适应我的工作流。

cues.en: So looking at the bottom left here, you can firstly see that all of my workspaces have icons.
cues.zh: 看左下角这里，首先你会看到我所有的工作区都有图标。

cues.en: I'll show you how to do that in the next video. You can see the workspace number one has a browser icon. As you can probably imagine, if I go to that workspace by pressing mod and one, it's there for my web browser.
cues.zh: 下个视频我会演示怎么设置。可以看到工作区一有个浏览器图标。你能想到，如果我按 mod 加 1 切过去，那就是我的网页浏览器。

cues.en: I can do my general browsing in here and if I want to open a second window, I often open an incognito window on the right hand side like this so I can invalidate cookies for web development purposes. Looking at the icon for workspace number two, you can probably guess that this is the workspace for my terminals.
cues.zh: 我可以在这儿日常浏览，如果想开第二个窗口，我经常在右边开个无痕窗口，这样在网页开发时就能让 cookie 失效。再看工作区二的图标，你大概能猜到这是放终端的。

cues.en: I have three terminals open right now, one for VIM, which is a code editor, one for my test runner, and one that I just have as a sort of general purpose command line for using things like git or listing things on the file system.
cues.zh: 我现在开着三个终端，一个用于 VIM，也就是代码编辑器，一个用于测试运行器，还有一个就是通用命令行，用来跑 git 或者列文件系统之类的事。

cues.en: On workspace number four, I've got OBS running. You see? Now this workspace has a question mark because whilst workspace number one, I always use for the browser and workspace number two, always use for my command lines.
cues.zh: 工作区四上，我跑着 OBS。看到了吧？这个工作区带个问号，因为工作区一我总用来放浏览器，工作区二总用来放命令行。

cues.en: Workspace four could be anything.
cues.zh: 工作区四则什么都有可能。

cues.en: Workspace nine however has got a chat icon because it's exclusively used for my chat applications
cues.zh: 而工作区九有个聊天图标，因为它是专门用来放聊天应用的。

cues.en: and workspace number 10 is exclusively used for my music player at the moment at Spotify.
cues.zh: 工作区十目前专门用来放我的音乐播放器 Spotify。

cues.en: Something that I think is incredible and this goes beyond just the basic functionality
cues.zh: 我觉得很神奇的一点，这已经超出了基本功能。

cues.en: is to say I quit out of Spotify and go back to workspace number one, I no longer have that workspace and I open Spotify.
cues.zh: 比如我退出 Spotify，回到工作区一，那个工作区就不在了，然后我再打开 Spotify。

cues.en: Look how it comes back again. I've configured I three in such a way that some applications automatically
cues.zh: 你看它又回来了。我把 i3 配置成某些应用会自动

cues.en: load on a particular workspace.
cues.zh: 加载到特定工作区。

cues.en: The reason why I think this is powerful is because I always know exactly where my windows are. If I want to get to the browser as quickly as I can think I want to be in the browser, I can press the mod key in one and I know that that's gonna take me there. I have confidence that that's where it'll take me. On other floating window managers, I would often have to press the alt and tab key to flick between windows or use the activity overview
cues.zh: 我认为这很强大的原因是，我总能确切知道我的窗口在哪里。如果我想尽快打开浏览器，只要按下 mod 键加 1，就知道它会带我去那里。我有信心它会带我到正确的地方。在其他浮动窗口管理器上，我常常得按 alt 加 tab 键在窗口间切换，或者用活动概览

cues.en: or might have to sort of move windows around because a window could be hidden behind another one. There's something about I three for me that makes it so, that I can express my intent very clearly and it's a very pleasurable experience. Honestly, I find it very satisfying.
cues.zh: 或者可能得挪动窗口，因为一个窗口可能被另一个挡住。对我来说，i3 有种特别之处，让我能非常清晰地表达意图，体验非常愉悦。老实说，我觉得非常满足。

cues.en: With that out of the way, let me quickly go back into the clean installation of Ubuntu and I'll show you a couple more things before finishing up here.
cues.zh: 说完这些，让我快速回到干净的 Ubuntu 安装环境，在结束前再给你展示几件事。

cues.en: Okay. So we're back in the virtual machine.
cues.zh: 好的。我们回到了虚拟机。

cues.en: If this was my workspace, I'd have Firefox here and I'd move these two terminals
cues.zh: 如果这是我的工作区，我会把 Firefox 放在这里，然后把这俩终端

cues.en: to workspace number two by pressing mod shift and then two as those windows are focused. Now a couple more things I'll show you in I three. First off, if you want to log out, what you need to do is press mod shift and e. You'll see this orange title bar at the top that asks you if you want to exit. You have to use your mouse button by default, but you can if you want to configure it to use your keyboard.
cues.zh: 移到二号工作区，只需在窗口聚焦时按 mod shift 加 2。现在我再给你展示 i3 的几个功能。首先，如果你想注销，需要按 mod shift 加 e。你会看到顶部出现橙色标题栏，询问你是否要退出。默认得用鼠标点击，但如果你愿意，也可以配置成用键盘操作。

cues.en: If you want to lock the screen, and this is the... This has to be the last thing I'll show you. I'll show... I'll tell you why in a second. Go to the terminal
cues.zh: 如果你想锁屏，这也是…… 这绝对是我要展示给你的最后一样东西。我待会儿…… 我过一会儿告诉你为什么。打开终端

cues.en: and type in I three lock, and this will bring an application called I three lock that basically makes your screen white. So if you pass certain arguments to the application, you can make it any color you want or even give it a background. And then as you type in your password, you get feedback to ensure that you're comfortable that you've actually entered the character. You hit enter, it says verifying,
cues.zh: 输入 i3lock，这会启动一个名为 i3lock 的应用程序，它基本上会让你的屏幕变白。所以如果你向该应用程序传递某些参数，你可以把它变成你想要的任何颜色，甚至可以给它设置一个背景。然后当你输入密码时，你会得到反馈，确保你确信自己确实输入了字符。你按下回车键，它会显示正在验证，

cues.en: and then eventually it'll tell me if it's wrong. I'll enter my correct password and...
cues.zh: 然后最终它会告诉我是否错误。我输入正确的密码，然后……

cues.en: Oh, it actually logged me in this time. I was just angling to say that last time I tried this on this particular machine, it wouldn't let me log in but it's working now. So that is no matter what the last thing I'm gonna show you though guys. Thank you very much for watching. Hopefully, now you know enough commands that you can start to install I three and then start using it for your daily purposes and get some first hand experience. At that point, you can decide whether it's something you want to stick with. I personally trialed it and loved it. You know, your mileage may vary, I hope you enjoy as much as I do. Thanks for watching, guys. Hopefully, I'll see you in the next video where I'm going to show you how to configure I three so you have things like custom key bindings and also make it look a lot nicer.
cues.zh: 哦，这次它真的把我登录进去了。我本来想说的是，上一次我在特定机器上尝试这个时，它不让我登录，但现在可以了。不管怎样，这真的是我要向大家展示的最后一样东西。非常感谢大家的观看。希望现在你们已经掌握了足够的命令，可以开始安装 i3`并将其用于日常需求，从而获得第一手经验。到那时，你可以决定这是否是你想要坚持使用的东西。我个人试用过并且非常喜欢。你知道的，每个人的体验可能不同，希望你们和我一样喜欢它。谢谢大家的观看。希望能在下一个视频中见到大家，届时我将向大家展示如何配置 i3，比如实现自定义快捷键之类的功能，并让它看起来更漂亮。
